definitions.explanation: Equipment installed in parks and playgrounds for children to play on, such as swings, slides, jungle gyms, and seesaws.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Children are playing on the playground equipment in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The old playground equipment was removed because it was dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧だ。
examples.english: New playground equipment was installed and the children are delighted.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {遊|ゆう} (play) and ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool/equipment). Used as a general term for all types of playground structures. Individual pieces of equipment have their own names: ブランコ (swings), ⟦{滑|すべ}り{台|だい}→滑り台：06325_suberidai⟧ (slide), ⟦ジャングルジム→ジャングルジム：29576_jangurujimu⟧ (jungle gym), ⟦シーソー→シーソー：29575_shiisoo⟧ (seesaw).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ (to play on playground equipment)
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧ (to install playground equipment)
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧ (inspection of playground equipment)
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}する→撤去する：21321_tekkyosuru⟧ (to remove playground equipment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧: toy — handheld playthings, not fixed structures
- ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: play tools — broader, includes toys and games
